title: Run side work in parallel
tagline: Keep the main work moving while small fixes land as their own pull requests, each in its own worktree.
needs: The core workflow running, or any long task you don't want interrupted
A repository you can add git worktrees to, inside a folder your runner allows
takeaway: A habit for clearing small tasks without breaking anyone's focus, yours included.
outcomes: Hand off small fixes without interrupting the main work
Run each in its own worktree and branch, so nothing collides
Land each as its own small pull request

lessons.title: Why side quests get in the way

quiz.question: Why give a side quest its own worktree instead of the coder's checkout?
options: Two agents in one checkout switch branches and commit each other's half-finished changes
quiz.why: A worktree is its own folder on its own branch, so the side quest can't touch the pair's work, and it lands as its own small pull request.

video.about: A fixer started in its own worktree, handed a task of its own, done without touching the pair.
